product.description:
Consort PVE 1kW Panel Heater with Electronic 7 Day Timer

The PVE panel heaters feature an electronic timer which enables you to programme a 7 day heating schedule, with up to 6 heating periods per day, allowing you to relax and get comfortable, knowing you've taken care of your heating in advance. These heaters have an in-built digital control panel with an easy-to-read display and large control buttons, including a switch to manually power the heater on or off. Other features include an electronic lock to prevent control tampering, 15 minute boosting periods, copy day function and open window detection.

The PVE heaters incorporate open window detection technology that recognises sudden drops in temperature when a window is opened and turns off to conserve energy, minimising wastage. Once the window is closed, the PVE panel heaters will detect the temperature change, triggering the heating to resume its normal operation.

These slimline heaters have been fitted with strengthened grilles, designed to increase durability and feature a snap-on bracket on their wall mounting system, ensuring easy installation and removal for cleaning, maintenance and decorating, making the PVE panel heaters an ideal heating solution for bedrooms, kitchens, bathrooms, laundries, offices and hotels.
